name: smwmusic-lost-desert
title: Lost Desert
description:
I originally made this song for a 100% free (with no in-game-real-money payments) sidescroller MMORPG game called Aeon Rivals back in 2017 when it was in development.

It was originally for the Lost Desert level, as the author was requesting for .XM music to be put into the game.

I gave the author this song and while he liked it, he couldn't put it in the game because I was 14 at the time, so I was too young to be able to receive payment without complications.

Of course, I'm still too young now, and it seems the game is already done, so I'll just upload the song here. Well, converted to AddMusicK MML.

This might not sound like most other desert themes. I tried to go not for the classic Saharan feel, but for a more southern US atmosphere that is also mysterious.

And yes, I lifted the drum samples from Evanescence's Bring Me To Life stems.
